$comment_commands: install, build and start each run from the repository root, independently. If the app is in a subdirectory, cd into it in all three.
$comment: Pages the dashboard shows for this project. CI starts the app on every push to the default branch, captures these, and uploads them. Images are never committed — only this file is. Delete this file to turn screenshots off. See docs/screenshots/README.md.
$comment_secrets: Every value this project needs at run time comes from ONE mechanism: a repository secret named SCREENSHOT_ENV_<NAME> arrives as <NAME>. So DATABASE_URL comes from a secret called SCREENSHOT_ENV_DATABASE_URL. Nothing here is a secret itself — this file is committed. List the names below and CI will refuse to start, and name them, rather than failing three minutes later with an unrelated error.
$comment_auth: Optional. Only needed when the interesting pages are behind a login. These are NAMES, resolved the same way as everything in `requires`. Delete the whole auth block for a public site.
$comment_pages: Numbered so they sort into the order a person meets them. Up to 12. Optional per page: fullPage, waitFor (a selector), waitMs.
$comment_ignore: Pages that are reachable but must not be photographed, so the coverage check stops reporting them. Anything showing an API key, invite link, join code or token belongs here - never in pages.
